about: Website templates for the designer (scripts/dev/site-gallery.py). Sources and licenses: docs/SITE-TEMPLATES.md. retired: no longer offered (its file still loads); alias: the closest offered one.

templates.title: Link in bio
templates.summary: For anyone with one link to give: a potter, a baker, a tutor. A photo, a line and a stack of buttons.

templates.title: Creator tiles
templates.summary: For streamers, musicians and makers with a lot going on: your links as a grid of tiles, the big ones first.

templates.title: Open-source project
templates.summary: For a tool that lives on GitHub: what it does, how to install it in one line, what changed, where the code is.

templates.title: App download page
templates.summary: For a phone or desktop app: one claim on a band of colour, the store buttons, a look inside, and the questions people ask.

templates.title: Send people to my app
templates.summary: For a short link you print or post: one small page that sends visitors on to your app store page, a download or any address.

templates.title: Product page
templates.summary: For a web product with plans: the real screen up front, what it does in uneven tiles, what it does not do yet, prices.

templates.title: Indie game page
templates.summary: For a game: the key art edge to edge with the title on it, the facts press ask for, screenshots and a devlog.

templates.title: Docs or handbook
templates.summary: For instructions people come back to: a guide, a handbook, a manual. The contents stay down the side; pages for each part.

templates.title: Coming soon
templates.summary: For something not open yet: one card that says what is coming and when, and a way to hear about it.

templates.title: Local service
templates.summary: For a trade that comes to you: plumber, electrician, cleaner, gardener. The phone number first, prices in a table, where you work.

templates.title: Café or restaurant
templates.summary: For a place people walk into: a picture across the top, the menu in two columns, a map beside the hours.

templates.title: Menu card
templates.summary: For a restaurant that only needs its menu online: courses and prices like a printed card, then hours and how to book.

templates.title: Store front
templates.summary: For selling a handful of things: the products first with their prices, how delivery works, and one honest way to order.

templates.title: Club or group
templates.summary: For a running club, a choir, a book group: when you next meet, set out like a timetable, and how a newcomer joins.

templates.title: Nonprofit or cause
templates.summary: For a charity or a campaign: the mission in very large type, three real numbers, what the money does, how to help.

templates.title: Portfolio
templates.summary: For designers, illustrators and studios: one sentence about what you do, then each project with its picture and its story.

templates.title: Photography
templates.summary: For photographers: the pictures fill the first screen in a mosaic, the words wait underneath.

templates.title: Resume
templates.summary: For job hunting: your name beside a short profile, your experience as a timeline, your skills as a plain list. Prints on one sheet.

templates.title: Personal letter
templates.summary: For a personal page, an about page or an open letter: one quiet column of writing with a signature, and nothing else in the way.

templates.title: Band or musician
templates.summary: For a band, a DJ, a choir on tour: the name across a stage photo like a gig poster, the dates as a list, the records.

templates.title: Wedding or party
templates.summary: For a wedding, a big birthday, a reunion: an invitation card, the day as a timeline, travel notes and an RSVP form.

templates.title: Conference or meetup
templates.summary: For a conference, a meetup, a festival day: the name huge, date and place under it, the programme by the hour, speakers, tickets.

templates.title: Class or course
templates.summary: For teaching something: a workshop, evening classes, an online course. The next start date in a card, week by week, the price.

templates.title: Blog or magazine
templates.summary: For writing regularly: the newest piece large with its picture, the rest in a column beside it, and a way to subscribe.

templates.title: Podcast
templates.summary: For a show: the cover and where to listen up top, then every episode as a plain running log.

templates.title: Dimension
templates.summary: A dark one-screen personal site: a name, four sections (intro, work, about, contact) and nothing else.

templates.title: Eventually
templates.summary: A coming-soon screen: one big line, an email signup, what's coming and where to follow along.

templates.title: Forty
templates.summary: A dark tiled portfolio with big project tiles and a contact block.

templates.title: Identity
templates.summary: A single centered card: avatar, name, a line, and your links.

templates.title: Landed
templates.summary: A product page with alternating spotlights and a signup.

templates.title: Massively
templates.summary: A big-type blog with a featured post and a grid of articles.

templates.title: Miniport
templates.summary: A personal portfolio: a hello, what I do, my work and contact.

templates.title: Photon
templates.summary: A clean product page with a big intro band, features and a call to action.

templates.title: Read Only
templates.summary: A one-person site with a sidebar feel: about, work, contact.

templates.title: Stellar
templates.summary: A friendly one-pager: intro, stats, features and get started.

templates.title: Artist links
templates.summary: For an illustrator or artist: commissions, prints, a few pieces and your socials.

templates.title: Coach or teacher links
templates.summary: For a coach, tutor or teacher: book a session, the free guide, and what people said.

templates.title: Developer links
templates.summary: For a developer or maker: your projects, GitHub, the blog and how to reach you.

templates.title: Musician links
templates.summary: Links for a singer, DJ or band: the new song first, your next shows, and where to listen.

templates.title: Shop links
templates.summary: For a maker who sells online: the shop, this week's drop with pictures, and a newsletter.

templates.title: Writer links
templates.summary: For a writer or newsletter: the latest piece, the book, talks, and a sign-up box.

templates.title: Agency
templates.summary: A studio or agency: services, portfolio grid, about timeline, team, contact.

templates.title: Business Casual
templates.summary: A warm small-business page with a story, opening hours and a promise.

templates.title: Business Frontpage
templates.summary: A plain business front page: headline, three features, a quote and a call to action.

templates.title: Clean Blog
templates.summary: A reading-first blog: big masthead, post list with dates, subscribe.

templates.title: Coming Soon
templates.summary: One screen, one line, an email signup for launch day.

templates.title: Creative
templates.summary: A bold one-pager for a creative service: services grid, portfolio, contact.

templates.title: Freelancer
templates.summary: A one-person portfolio: avatar, work grid, about in two columns, contact.

templates.title: Grayscale
templates.summary: A dark, quiet product page with projects side by side and a signup.

templates.title: Landing Page
templates.summary: The classic landing page: signup hero, three icons, alternating showcase, testimonials.

templates.title: Modern Business
templates.summary: A company site: hero, features, a testimonial, blog teasers, call to action.

templates.title: New Age
templates.summary: An app launch page: phone mockup hero, features, a quote, download buttons.

templates.title: One Page Wonder
templates.summary: Three big alternating picture-and-text rows under a loud hero.

templates.title: Personal
templates.summary: A personal home page: who you are, what you do, selected projects, experience and how to reach you.

templates.title: Resume
templates.summary: A resume as a web page: about, experience, education, skills, interests.

templates.title: Small Business
templates.summary: A small company: a picture and a pitch, a call-out band, three services, reviews, hours and a quote form.

templates.title: Stylish Portfolio
templates.summary: A portfolio with services, a full-width call-out and a project grid.

templates.title: App Landing
templates.summary: A dark app page: one claim, store buttons, a screenshot.

templates.title: Ghostwind
templates.summary: A magazine-style blog home: a featured post, a grid of posts, an author box.

templates.title: Tailwind Landing
templates.summary: A friendly product landing page: hero, two feature rows, pricing, call to action.

templates.title: Minimal Blog
templates.summary: One quiet column of writing with a subscribe box.

templates.title: Nordic Store
templates.summary: A calm product shop: a hero banner, a product grid, about the store.

templates.title: Profile Card
templates.summary: One card: photo, name, a few lines and your links.
